description: This file defines the CustomField model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin module. It manages CRUD operations for custom fields used in the customer section, including associated descriptions, customer groups, and values. It provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving custom field records and related entities from the database.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Model class for managing custom fields related to customers in the OpenCart admin module. Handles CRUD operations and related data management.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field record in the database, including descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field record and its related descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field record and its associated descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches a list of custom fields based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total count of custom fields matching filtering criteria.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for a custom field in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions that belong to a specific language.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Assigns a custom field to a customer group with optional requirement flag.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a given custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all customer groups associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new value to a custom field, including localized descriptions.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a custom field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field value by its ID.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Fetches all values for a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a custom field value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific custom field value.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for the values of a custom field.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all value descriptions for a specific language.
